renders: A chat or trawl results envelope: search hits across conversations, annotated and rendered together.

Data as something readable rather than a raw blob: a CSV, a JSON array, a log, in a multi-mode viewer (table, tree, preview, code, raw). Bare bytes need no wrapper; an items envelope adds several files with a default view each.

A PDF as a document you can take apart: the page drawn, with text containers, characters, vector rules, detected columns and lattice cells as toggleable layers over it, and the table read two independent ways so agreement is visible. The data route shows a PDF too, as a first look; this one is the workbench.

A document to adjudicate a shortening against, word-diffed into accept-by-default edits. Bare text fills the left column and leaves the shorter version to you or the in-browser model; an envelope carrying both sides opens straight into review.
